Add 1 additional [equipment] Upgrade to your Creature's Upgrade Banner.

If your Mount Upgrade is about to be discarded by an opponent, you may discard this Upgrade instead, even if this Upgrade is disabled or has [DT] tokens on it.

If you have a Mount Upgrade, you may place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade to add +1 attack die to your Primary Weapon attack.

If you have a Mount Upgrade, you may place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade to add +1 attack die to an Upgrade Attack if that attack requires you to have a Mount equipped.

name: Whirlwind
text:
*Attack:* Disable this Upgrade and place 3 [DT] on it to make a *3 Dice Attack* against every Creature within Range 1 in every direction (ground and air). Armor cannot be used to deflect this attack. You may spin each Creature that is damaged by this attack either 90 degrees or 180 degrees in the direction of your choice; you cannot spin Obstacles or similar objects. After you conclude this attack, place an Exhaustion Token beside your Creature.

*Must be a Air Elemental to equip.*

name: Sulfurous Smoke
text:
*Action:* Disable this Upgrade and then place 1 [DT] on it to force every Creature in a Range 2 Cone (ground *and* air) in your forward arc to receive the Continuous Effect below.

*Continuous Effect:* The affected Creatures lose all Target Tokens and roll -1 attack die in combat.

*Must be a Nightmare to equip.*

name: Tortured Nature
text:
Whenever you receive critical damage, you may disable this Upgrade to discard the first face up Damage Card that is drawn and replace it with a new face up Damage Card.

*Must be Evil to equip.*

*Cost: +2 for non-Nightmares*

name: Death Knight
text:
Each time you defend against a Primary Weapon Melee Attack, you may roll +1 defense dice.

You may also make the following attack once during each Combat Phase.

*Attack:* Make a *4 Dice Attack* against 1 Creature at Range 1 in your forward arc. This is considered a Primary Weapon attack. This is a free attack that does not count as your 1 attack for this round.

*Must be a Nightmare to equip.*

*You cannot equip another Rider Upgrade.*

name: Saddle of the Cavalier
text:

name: Flaming Hooves
text:
During a Primary Weapon Hoof attack against a non - [Fire] Creature, if any of your damage is about to be deflected by your target's Armor during the Deflect Hits step of Combat, you may disable this Upgrade to penetrate the opponent's Armor.

*Must be a Nightmare to equip.*

name: Ethereal Stride
text:
*Action:* Place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* You cannot attack. You are unaffected by Actions or attacks made by other Creatures. You are unaffected by Obstacles of any kind, and can pass through enemy Creatures without performing an Overrun Check. After you move, you may remove the Ethereal Stride Effect Token from beside your Creature, thereby ending this Effect. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

*Must be a Nightmare to equip.*

name: Sleep Breath
text:
*Attack:* Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to make a *2 Dice Attack* against every Creature in a Range 3 Cone (ground or air) in your forward arc. This attack penetrates Armor. If you inflict at least 1 damage against a Creature, it sustains no damage but receives the Continuous Effect below.

*Continuous Effect:* Each affected Creature receives a Sleep Token (see Reference Card). When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

*Cost: +5 for non-Brass Dragons*

name: Flame Breath
text:
*Attack:* Use your Primary Weapon Value to make a separate attack against each Creature in a Range 4 Line (ground or air) in your forward arc. This attack penetrates Armor.

Afterwards, place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Cost: Dragon's Primary Weapon Value (+5 for non-Fire Dragons)*

*You cannot also equip Fire Breath.*

name: Heroic Allies
text:
Every Unique, friendly, non-Troop Creature that shares your Alignment and that possesses at least 1 Heroic Icon on its Upgrade Banner is considered one of your “Heroic Allies.”

*Action:* Place 1 [PDT] on this Upgrade to bestow the Continuous Effect below on each of your Heroic Allies.

*Continuous Effect*: Each affected Creature has +1 Health Value.

*Must have a large base to equip.*

name: Scorch
text: During the Combat Phase, you may target 1 Dragon that was just damaged by your Flame Breath. That Dragon must choose and discard 1 of its [Dragon] Upgrades.

name: Sleet Storm
text:
*Attack:* Place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade and spend your Concentrate Token to place the Burst Token anywhere within Range 1 - 3 of your forward arc. The Burst Token receives the Continuous Effect below.

*Continuous Effect:* Creatures with an Agility of 0 who are touching or within Range 1 - 2 of the Burst Token cannot move, change altitude, perform Actions, or attack. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

name: Half-Elf Bard
text:
*Action:* Place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade. You and all friendly Creatures within Range 1 - 2 of you receive the Continuous Effect below. 

*Continuous Effect:* Each affected Creature may convert 1 [Concentrate] result into 1 [Critical] result the first time that it attacks during the Combat Phase. 

*Must have a large base to equip.*

*You cannot equip another Dragonrider Upgrade.*

name: Telekinesis
text:
*Action:* Disable this Upgrade to target 1 Creature at Range 1 - 3 in your forward arc. Disable 1 Upgrade of your choice on that Creature.

*You may then perform an Action on your Action Bar as a free Action.*

*A Vrock Demon can use a Monster Upgrade slot to equip this Spell.*

name: Telepathic Commander
text:
*Action:* Place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade. You and all friendly Evil Creatures within Range 1 - 3 of you receive the Continuous Effect below.

*Continuous Effect:* Each affected Creature may convert 1 blank result into 1 [Hit] result the first time that it attacks during the Combat Phase.

*Must be a Nalfeshnee Demon to equip.*

name: Demonic Teleportation
text:
*Action:* Discard this Upgrade to move your Creature (and all associated tokens) to a new position anywhere within the play area that is not overlapping another Creature or Obstacle; you may also change altitude and face any direction. Afterwards, you receive an Exhaustion Token. You cannot attack this round.

*Must be a Balor, Marilith, or Nalfeshnee Demon to equip.*

name: Party Leader
text:
*Action*: Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to allow yourself and every friendly Adventurer within Range 1 - 3 of you (on your play level) to immediately perform an Action on its Action Bar as a free Action. 

An "Adventurer" is defined as a Unique Creature on a small base with at least 1 [Heroic] Icon on its Upgrade Banner. 

Troops and Siege Weapons are not considered Adventurers. 

*Must be an Adventurer to equip.*

name: Stunning Screech
text:
*Attack:* Place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade to make a *3 Dice Attack* against every non-Demon Creature within Range 1 of you in every direction (ground *and* air). This attack penetrates Armor. If you inflict at least 1 damage against a Creature, it sustains no damage but receives the Continuous Effect below.

*Continuous Effect:* Each affected Creature cannot attack. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

*Must be a Vrock Demon to equip.*

name: Greater Dispel Magic
text:
*Action:* Disable this Upgrade to remove 1 Effect Token corresponding to a Spell Upgrade from yourself or 1 other Creature at Range 1 - 3 in any direction. You may then perform an Action on your Action Bar as a free Action.

*Must be a Sorceror, Wizard, Warlock, or Nalfeshnee Demon to equp.*

*A Nalfeshnee Demon can use a Monster Upgrade slot to equip this Spell.*

name: Dance of Ruin
text:
*Action:* Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* You cannot attack. If you sustain lethal damage, you must immediately remove the Dance of Ruin Effect Token from play and discard this card. At the end of the Combat Phase, if there is exactly 1 [DT] on this Upgrade and you still have the Dance of Ruin Effect Token beside you, every non-Demon Creature within Range 1 - 4 of you in all directions (ground *and* air) sustains 2 [Lightning] damage that penetrates Armor. Afterwards, remove the Dance of Ruin Effect Token from play and discard this card.

*Must be a Vrock Demon to equip.*

name: Horror Nimbus
text:
*Attack:* Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to force every non-Demon Creature within Range 1 - 2 of you in every direction (ground *and* air) to receive the Continuous Effect below.

*Continuous Effect:* Each affected Creature cannot perform any Actions. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard the card.

*Must be a Nalfeshnee Demon to equip.*

name: Finger of Death
text:
*Attack*: Discard this Upgrade and spend your Target Token to make a Ranged Attack against 1 Creature at Range 1 - 3 in your forward arc. During this attack, roll a number of attack dice equal to the target Creature's starting Health Value. This attack ignores Armor.

*Must be a Sorceror, Warlock, or Wizard to equip.*

name: Finger of Death
text:
*Attack*: Discard this Upgrade and spend your Target Token to make a Ranged Attack against 1 Creature at Range 1 - 3 in your forward arc. During this attack, roll a number of attack dice equal to the target Creature's starting Health Value. This attack ignores Armor.

*Must be a Druid to equip.*

name: True Seeing
text:
*Action:* Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* Whenever you attack, the defender cannot benefit from any Spell Effects during the Roll Defense Dice, Modify Defense Dice, or Compare Results Steps of Combat.

*A Balor, Glabrezu, Marilith, or Nalfeshnee Demon can use a Monster Upgrade slot to equip this Spell.*

name: Sack of Rotten Meat
text:
Any Creature attacking you at Range 1 rolls -1 attack die.

*Attack:* Discard this Upgrade to place the Burst Token anywhere within Range 1 - 2 of your forward arc. Make a *2 Dice Attack* against every Creature that is touching or within Range 1 of the Burst Token (ground or air). This attack penetrates Armor. Any Creatures damaged by this attack cannot attack for the remainder of the Round.

*Must be a Goblin Troop to equip.*

name: Grixom
text:
After an opponent declares an attack against one or more Soldiers in your Troop, you may disable this Upgrade to change your Point Soldier, even if this makes your formation illegal.

Whenever you lose a Soldier, you must roll 1 attack die, even if this card is disabled. If you roll a [Critical] result, discard this card.

*Must be an Evil Troop to equip. You cannot equip another Leader Upgrade.*

name: Dust of Disappearance
text:
*Action:* Place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* You cannot attack. You are immune to all attacks except for Cnoe and Burst attacks. If you are engulfed in a Cone or Burst attack, roll +2 defense dice against that attack. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

*A Troop can use a Heroic Upgrade slot to equip this Artifact.*

name: Plan of Attack
text:
After performing an Action listed on one of your Upgrades, you may disable this Upgrade to perform 1 Action listed on your Action Bar as a free Action.

*Must be a Troop to equip.*

name: Capricious
text:
At the start of the Declare Target step of Combat, if you are the attacker and no game effect is prohibiting you from changing altitude, you may discard this Upgrade to change your altitude as you normally would during the Change Altitude step of the Activation Phase. After using this ability, place an Exhaustion Token beside your Creature.

*Must be a flying Creature to equip.*

name: Fearsome
text:
Each Creature that you attack rolls -1 defense die if you are in that Creature's forward arc.

*Must have a large base to equip.*

name: Vantage
text:
During a Primary Weapon Ranged attack, if your target is at Range 3 or 4, you may convert 1 of your [Hit] results into 1 [Crit] result.

text: *Attack:* Disable this Upgrade and spend your Concentrate Token to make a *4 Dice Attack* against every Creature in a Range 3 Cone (ground or air) in your forward arc. This attack penetrates Armor.

text:
*Attack:* Disable this Upgrade and place 2 [DT] on it to force every non-[Poison] Creature within Range 1 of you in every direction (ground *and* air) to receive the Continuous Effect below.

name: Gaseous Form
text:
*Action:* Place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* You receive a Gaseous Form Token (see Reference Card). When this Effect ends, discard this card; if you were in the air and you cannot fly, you land immediately (and safely).

name: Poison Breath
text:

name: Wand of the War Mage
text:
After rolling the attack dice during a Spell Attack, you may disable this Upgrade to re-roll your entire attack roll.

*You cannot equip a Weapon Upgrade.*

name: Debilitating Poison
text:
During the Combat Phase, you may target 1 Creature that was just damaged by your Poison Breath. That Creature receives the Continuous Effect below. Place 2 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* If the affected Creature's Primary Weapon Value is greater than 3, the Creature is considered to have a Primary Weapon Value of 3. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

*You cannot also equip Toxic Affliction.*

name: Heave Goblin
text:
You must have at least 2 Soldiers in your Troop to initiate the following attack.

*Attack:* Disable this Upgrade to attack 1 Creature at Range 1 - 3 in your forward arc. Roll a number of attack dice equal to your Primary Weapon Value + 2. Afterwards, remove 1 Soldier of your choice from your Troop as if it were defeated, and then discard the top Troop Token on your Creature Card.

*Must be a Goblin Troop to equip.*

name: Territorial
text:
If you are attacking while your Creature base is within Range 1 - 4 of your starting edge, you may discard this Upgrade at the start of the Roll Attack Dice step of Combat to roll +3 attack dice.

You may measure to make sure you are within Range 1 - 4 of your starting edge before deciding to activate this card.

*Must be a Green Dragon to equip.*

name: Sleep
text:
*Attack:* Spend your Target Token and place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to make a *2 Dice Attack* against 1 Creature at Range 1 - 3 in your forward arc. This attack penetrates Armor. If you inflict at least 1 damage against the Creature, it sustains no damage but receives the Continuous Effect below.

name: Intimidation
text:
*Action:* If the total number of your allied Creatures (including you and all friendly Creatures) is greater than the total number of an opponent's Creatures in the play area, place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* Whenever you or one of your allies attacks one of that opponent's Creatures, the attacker may convert 1 of his [Concentrate] results into 1 [Hit] result.

*Must be a Unique Dragon to equip.*

name: Eyes of the Eagle
text:
If you have the [Target] Action listed on your Creature card, you may perform the [Target] Action even if there are no enemies within Range 4.

During a Ranged attack, your targets do not receive the Defensive Combat Bonus for being attacked at Range 4.

*A Dragon can use a Dragon Upgrade slot to equip this Artifact.*

name: Exploit Weakness
text:
After performing a [Feint] Action, you may disable this Upgrade and then place 1 [DT] on it. 

*Continuous Effect:* During a Primary Weapon attack, if any of your damage is about to be deflected by your target’s Armor during the Deflect Hits step of Combat, you may choose to penetrate the opponent’s Armor. If you do so, remove your Exploit Weakness Effect Token from play.

name: Skulk
text:
After performing a [Dodge], [Target], or [Concentrate] Action, you may disable this Upgrade to perform the [Feint] Action as a free Action.

name: Venomous Bite
text:
*Attack:* Use your Primary Weapon Value to attack a Creature at Range 1 in your forward arc. This is considered a Primary Weapon Melee [Poison] attack. If you inflict at least 1 damage against the Creature, place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to force the Creature to receive the Continuous Effect below in addition to the damage.

text:
You may disable this Upgrade to roll +1 attack die when attacking with your Primary Weapon Bow attack; this attack is now considered a [Poison] attack.

*A Harpy can use a Monster Upgrade slot to equip this Bow.*

name: Web
text:
*Attack:* Disable this Upgrade, place 2 [DT] on it, and spend your Concentrate Token to place the Burst Token anywhere within Range 1 - 3 of your forward arc. The Burst Token receives the Continuous Effect below.

All Creatures except for Driders and Spiders who are within Range 1 - 2 of the Burst Token cannot perform Actions, change altitude, or choose a Maneuver with a number greater than “1”.

name: Malicious Glee
text:
After you inflict at least 1 critical damage to a Creature, you may immediately place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade to remove 1 Disabled Token from 1 of your [Heroic] Upgrades. You may only do this once after an attack, even if you inflict 2 or more critical damage to the enemy.

*Must be a Evil Troop to equip.*

name: Goblin Conscripts
text:
You must have 2, 3, 4, or 5 Soldiers in your Troop to perform the following Action.

*Action:* Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to add 1 Soldier to your Troop. Add the next sequential Troop Token to your Creature Card. This Action has no effect if the next sequential Troop Token is on top of the "Moment of Glory" Upgrade.

*Must be a Goblin Troop to equip.*

name: Break Resistance
text:
*Action:* Discard this Upgrade to target 1 Creature at Range 1 - 2 in your forward arc. Disable 1 Upgrade of your choice on that Creature.

OR

*Action:* Discard this Upgrade to target 1 Creature at Range 1 - 2 in your forward arc. Discard 1 Resistance Upgrade of your choice on that Creature.

name: Monstrous Regeneration
text:
Each time you receive at least 1 point of [Fire] or [Acid] damage, you must place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade. You must do this once (and only once) each time you are damaged by [Fire] or [Acid], no matter how much damage you receive.

*Action:* Place 3 [DT] on this Upgrade to remove 1 of your face down Damage Cards or to flip 1 of your face up Damage Cards face down.

*Must be an Ogre Mage or Troll to equip.*

name: Ancient Lore
text:
Add 1 additional [Heroic] Upgrade to yoru Creature's Upgrade Banner.

Ancient Dragons who are within Range 1 - 4 of you in your forward arc cannot perform a [Charge] Action or a [Feint] Action.

*Must be Level 9+ to equip.*

name: Magic Glaive
text:
Your Primary Weapon Melee attacks can tatget Creatures at +1 Range Increment (maximum of Range 4).

text:

Afterwards, you may perform an Action on your Action Bar as a free Action.

text:

*Continuous Effect:* The affected Creature rolls -1 attack die and -1 defense die whenever it is in combat.

*Must be a Beholder to equip.*

name: Death Ray
text:

name: Rowlfee
text:
*Attack:* Place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade to make a *2 Dice Attack* against 1 Creature at Range 1 in your forward arc. This is considered a Primary Weapon Melee [Disease] Attack that ignores Armor. This is a free attack that does not count as your 1 attack for this round.

*Must be a Goblin to equip.*

name: Foul Scheme
text:

*Must be a Dracolich to equip.*

name: Fiendish Tyrant
text:
*Action:* Place 1 [DT] on this Upgrade.

*Continuous Effect:* All friendly Evil Creatures within Range 1 - 3 of you in all directions roll +1 attack die against Neutral Creatures and +2 attack dice against Good Creatures. When this Effect ends for any reason, discard this card.

*Must be Tiamat or a Dracolich to equip.

name: Hunger of Hadar
text:
*Attack:* Disable this Upgrade, place 1 [DT] on it, and spend your Concentrate Token to place the Burst Token anywhere within Range 1 - 3 of your forward arc. The Burst Token receives the Continuous Effect below.

During the End Phase, every Creature within Range 1 of the Burst Token sustains 1 point of [Acid] damage (ground *and* air). name: Shadowfell Bite
text:
If you inflict at least 1 damage against a Creature with your Bite attack, the Creature suffers 1 additional [Negative] damage.

name: Cloak of Invisibility
text:

Each time you defend, roll +1 defense die. A Creature equipped with a Gem of Seeing or under the effect of a True Seeing Spell can spend its Target Token against you, and you do not roll +1 defense die against such a Creature.

name: Wealth of the Ancients
text:
You may equip one [Dragon] Campaign Artifact at a cost of -2 Legion Points. This Campaign Artifact takes up one of your [Dragon] Upgrade slots as normal, but the Artifact does not count towards your Legion's total number of Campaign Artifacts.

*Must be a Black Dragon to equip.*

name: Mithral Full Plate
text:
You have a base Armor Value of 2. During the Compare Results Step of Combat, if you are defending against a Primary Weapon your [Dodge] results cancel [Critical] results before cancelling [Hit] results.
